## Implementation notes
- `crates/hh-helper` (new persistent crate + `hh-helper` binary):
  `protocol.rs` (closed `hh-helper/1` verb sum, strict parse,
  `mint_commit_proof`/`verify_commit_proof` = `idp_id("commit_token",
  nonce ∥ effect_id ∥ attempt_no)`), `wire.rs` (NDJSON frames over the
  shared `hh-wire` codec), `server.rs` (session loop: `hello`,
  `resume_session_id`, per-verb dispatch, `DedupStore` +
  `preserve_until` under `tier-c1`, typed `unsupported` refusals
  without it), `exec.rs` (spawn as pgrp leader, stdout/stderr pumps
  with `retain_bytes_cap`, deadline watcher TERM→KILL on the group,
  detached-member detection at reap — record before pump join so a
  stray holding inherited pipes is surfaced immediately),
  `seatbelt.rs` (`local_sandboxed` — generated SBPL deny-default
  profile, writable roots only, `deny network*`, sysctl/loader
  allowances), `podman.rs` (`local_container` — `docker://` images,
  `--network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL`, workspace bind mount,
  `podman stats` meters, runtime-absent ⇒ `Unavailable`),
  `fstree.rs` (`tree/1` content-addressed manifests: snapshot /
  verify / restore / diff).
- `crates/hh-env`: `helper.rs` (`HelperClient` — connect-retry to the
  persisted short socket, `exec` mints `commit_proof` from the
  session nonce + committed members, attribution token echo enforced
  frame-by-frame — wrong/absent echo drops the item and appends
  `action.effect.unattributed`), `executor.rs` (`HelperExecutor`
  implementing `ToolExecutor` over the wire), `driver.rs`
  (`start_helper`/`resume_helper`, `mark_unreachable`/`reattach`/
  `replace`/`heal` ladder with `on_loss` semantics and
  `action.world_state.discontinuity`, `derive` modes, `fs_tree`
  verbs, per-class meters), `dispatch.rs` (commit evidence threading),
  `handle.rs`/`record.rs`/`events.rs`/`protocol.rs`/`local.rs`/
  `errors.rs` (record/event/error surface).
- AF_UNIX 104-byte limit on darwin: sockets live under
  `std::env::temp_dir()` in a content-derived short dir
  (`hh-<idp(store_root)>/s-*.sock`); `{session_id, nonce, sock_path}`
  persist under the store root so `resume` rebinds exactly.
- `scripts/check-removability.sh` — removability(0): builds
  `hh-helper --no-default-features`, drives a live session proving
  `preserve_until`/`dedup_window` ⇒ typed `unsupported` while tier-0
  `exec` still runs (HH_REM0 gate in `helper_live.rs`), then restores
  `tier-c1` and re-runs the full 15-test suite (removability(1)).
- Fixes landed during the run: detached-child reap ordering (record
  terminal state before joining output pumps); deadline classification
  recorded before terminal notify (`deadline_exceeded`, not generic);
  live tests use explicit `argv` (classifier `Parsed`, no shell
  metachar `Partial`→ask); compensable effects carry compensation
  plans; `hh-helper` rebuilt explicitly in the removability leg
  (stale-binary hazard documented in the test).
